text:
alex: Heads-up — canary promotion for v1.12.3 is blocked, deploybot is failing to promote the manifest.

maria: seeing the same. Deploybot logs show a 404 from the artifact registry on manifest lookup.

deploybot: promotion halted for tag redwood/canary:v1.12.3 — manifest not found in registry replication region eu-west-1 (HTTP 404). Retrying in 30s.

sam: is this the same manifest that passed earlier in staging? commit 7f3a9b2

alex: yes, same commit. staging -> canary promotion started at 09:12 and then we see: `error: manifest missing for digest sha256:ab12...` in the deploybot job.

maria: artifact upload job finished successfully from build node, but registry returned 202 then async replication. possible propagation lag. I can query replication status.

sre-bot: registry-replication-check: replication lag detected for bucket artifacts-uploads (avg 3m 42s over last 10m).

jen: e2e flakiness also popped in canary after a couple of retries — failing `test_auth_flow` intermittently. Could be related to missing feature flag or the partial promotion?

sam: tagging note: the canary image digest exists in primary region us-east but not yet in eu-west due to replication. deploybot tried to fetch by tag which resolves to digest only in eu-west and failed. We should promote by digest to avoid race.

alex: two questions — (1) do we wait for replication or (2) pin to digest and force promotion? Waiting delays the cut. We're in the 10:00-12:00 change window and need to decide.

maria: If we wait we might see flakiness go away. But if replication is inconsistent, we could get partial traffic to some regions. For safety, pin by digest and re-run deploybot with `--force-digest` would be faster.

release-manager: given customer SLA, if we can promote by digest and run quick smoke in eu-west, do it. But do not full roll out until smoke passes. Also update release notes with the manual promotion and the reason.

alex: action plan: (1) maria to verify digest exists in origin (us-east) and share digest, (2) sam will run a manual promotion command pinned to digest, (3) jen will kick a eu-west smoke job and monitor, (4) I'll hold canary traffic at 0% and only open if smoke green.

maria: digest is sha256:ab12cdef3456. Confirmed in us-east. Registry list shows missing in eu-west.

sam: running manual promotion: `deploybot promote --from staging --to canary --digest sha256:ab12cdef3456 --region eu-west-1 --reason "manifest replication lag"`

deploybot: [INFO] promotion job queued (manual). job_id=prom-20260315-17. Attempting blob mount from us-east -> eu-west.

deploybot: [ERROR] blob mount failed: registry blob mount denied (403) for digest sha256:ab12cdef3456. Falling back to pull+push.

sam: ugh mount denied — registry permissions? Did our cross-region service account token expire?

maria: checking IAM. The cross-region mount role rotated keys at 03:00 UTC; the rotation should have updated registry tokens but looks like our token wasn't distributed to eu-west. Investigating.

jen: smoke job queued but won't run until the image is present. Job id smoke-553.

alex: if mount is failing, fallback (pull+push) will re-upload artifact to eu-west which is slower and will triple network egress. Still probably faster than waiting for ops to roll out token fix. Sam — can you re-run promotion with `--pull-push` and set a safety TTL?

sam: re-running: `deploybot promote --from staging --to canary --digest sha256:ab12cdef3456 --region eu-west-1 --method pull-push --safety-ttl 10m`

deploybot: [INFO] pull+push started. estimated 90s to complete.

sre-bot: note: this will incur egress charges and may saturate the staging node's network. Monitor `net.out` on build-staging-1.

maria: done — artifact pushed to eu-west. Manifest now available. `registryctl manifest get sha256:ab12cdef3456` returns 200.

deploybot: promotion completed. job_id=prom-20260315-17. canary tag updated to sha256:ab12cdef3456 in eu-west.

jen: kicking smoke now — `/run smoke smoke-553 eu-west-1`

jen: smoke job green for core flows, auth smoke still flaky in earlier run. rerunning flaky test now.

jen: second smoke run — `test_auth_flow` passed. No regressions in 3 consecutive runs.

release-manager: good. open canary to 5% gradually over 30m. Add note: rollout used digest pin and pull+push due to registry replication/permission issue. Follow-up with infra to fix token distribution.

alex: adding release note snippet: "Canary promoted manually via digest (sha256:ab12cdef3456) after registry replication and mount errors; staged rollout at 5% with smoke verification. No functional regressions observed."

sam: created a follow-up ticket infra#2189: "registry cross-region mount token distribution failed during key rotation — investigate and add monitoring". Assigning to infra oncall.

maria: learned: prefer promoting by digest in automated pipeline when cross-region promotion is used; will raise a small change to deploybot to fallback to digest promotion automatically.

alex: thanks all. I'll hold on the full release promotion until infra confirms token fix or we add digest automatic fallback. For now canary is live at 5% and monitoring. :shipit:

deploybot: reaction :white_check_mark:
